resources.string: Where you learn, study, and imitate.
Pick the folder that holds your book (or several books). Each folder inside it is shown as a card, and folders can hold more folders, e.g. a book with a folder for each chapter.
No folders or study files found here. Put PDF, Word or audio files in this folder, or in folders inside it, e.g. one for each book or chapter.
The book folder can no longer be read. Please choose it again.
Choose a file from the list
No app installed can open this file
Clear: erase all tracing on screen
Write with a finger or stylus. Scroll and zoom with two fingers.
No %1$s voice is installed. Add it in Settings (⋮ on the main screen) → Download all.
Offer to download when a feature needs it
Hok6 works offline. The dictionary is built in; handwriting recognition and the voices come from the internet once.

Turn on Wi-Fi and tap Download all. Handwriting downloads here; for voices, Android opens its voice screen: download Chinese (Hong Kong) and Chinese (China), then come back. You can skip and download any time in Settings.
Couldn\'t download. Check Wi-Fi and try again.
Not installed: added in Android\'s voice settings
Install Speech Services by Google, then come back to Hok6 and tap Download all again.
Set the preferred engine to Speech Services by Google, then ⚙ → Install voice data → Chinese (Hong Kong) and Chinese (China).
Download Chinese (Hong Kong) and Chinese (China), then come back to Hok6.
Writing by hand needs the %1$s handwriting recognition, a one-time download (Wi-Fi recommended). After that it works offline.
Hearing words needs a %1$s voice. Android adds voices in its own settings; Hok6 will open the right screen for you.
Tap the characters you want to practice.
No Chinese characters were found on this page.
This page is an image, so the characters were recognised from it — check they\'re right. Tap the ones you want to practice.
Reading the characters on this page…
The selection has no Chinese characters
Practice Selector (tap a character to practice writing it)
Practice Selector: tap a character to practice writing it. Tap the pen to write again.
Tap right on a Chinese character
Backup saved. Keep a copy off the tablet too (e.g. on a computer) to restore after reinstalling.

This book folder has a Hok6 backup (%1$s). Restore it to bring back your writing practice, tracing and quiz? It\'s added to anything already in Hok6.\n\nIf you don\'t restore it, it\'s replaced by a backup of your work from now on.
Hok6 now keeps a backup of your work in your book folder (Hok6 backup.json), so it\'s safe if Hok6 is removed.\n\nTap Choose folder, pick the same book folder again, then tap Allow.
Restored: %1$d words in history, tracing on %2$d files
That file isn\'t a Hok6 backup
Folder name, e.g. Chapter 3 or Book 2
A name can\'t start with a dot or contain / \\ : * ? \" < > |
There is already a folder called %1$s
Not moved, because %1$s already has a file with the same name:\n%2$s
To move files and make folders, Hok6 needs permission to change your book folder.\n\nTap Choose folder, pick the same book folder again, then tap Allow.
That\'s a different folder. Choose your book folder to allow changes.
Save a copy with my tracing…
A new PDF with your tracing drawn in is saved in this folder. The original isn\'t changed.
Nothing traced on this file yet
%1$s is already in this folder. Replace it?\n\nWhat\'s in it now, and any tracing on it, will be lost.
%1$s is the file you\'re working on. Replacing it draws your tracing into the page for good: it can\'t be erased or undone afterwards.
Added %1$d to the quiz (%2$d in it now). Open Writing practice → Quiz.
